findings.title: Hard-coded secret
findings.remediation: Revoke the credential, move it to an environment variable or secret manager, and remove it from git history.

findings.title: Hard-coded framework secret key
findings.remediation: Load the key from an environment variable or a secret manager and fail to start when it is missing.

findings.title: Debug mode enabled
findings.remediation: Set APP_DEBUG=false (and NODE_ENV=production) for every deployed environment.

findings.title: Hard-coded secret
findings.remediation: Revoke the credential, move it to an environment variable or secret manager, and remove it from git history.

findings.title: Database password written in Django settings
findings.remediation: Read the password from an environment variable, for example os.environ['DB_PASSWORD'].

findings.title: SQL query built from string formatting
findings.message: Query is built from a formatted string
findings.remediation: Use parameterised queries: cursor.execute(sql, params), PreparedStatement with ?, or FromSqlInterpolated / SqlParameter in .NET.

findings.title: Unsafe code execution or deserialization in Python
findings.message: Code or command is built dynamically
findings.remediation: Avoid eval and exec. Pass subprocess an argument list without shell=True, use json instead of pickle, and yaml.safe_load instead of yaml.load.

findings.title: Unsafe code execution or deserialization in Python
findings.remediation: Avoid eval and exec. Pass subprocess an argument list without shell=True, use json instead of pickle, and yaml.safe_load instead of yaml.load.

findings.title: README missing or nearly empty
findings.remediation: Describe what the project does, how to install, run and test it.

findings.title: No automated tests detected
findings.message: No test files or test directories found
findings.remediation: Add a test runner (Jest/Vitest, PHPUnit/Pest) and cover the critical paths.

findings.title: Django accepts any Host header
findings.remediation: List the real host names in ALLOWED_HOSTS, for example ['example.com'].

findings.title: CSRF protection disabled
findings.remediation: Keep CSRF protection on for cookie-based sessions; disable it only for stateless token APIs, and scope the exemption to those endpoints.

findings.title: Session cookies not hardened
findings.remediation: Enable the Secure and HttpOnly flags for session and CSRF cookies.

findings.title: Session cookies not hardened
findings.remediation: Enable the Secure and HttpOnly flags for session and CSRF cookies.

findings.title: Permissive CORS in a Python, Java or .NET API
findings.remediation: List the exact origins that need access instead of '*'.

findings.title: Unsafe code execution or deserialization in Python
findings.message: pickle.loads can run code from untrusted data
findings.remediation: Avoid eval and exec. Pass subprocess an argument list without shell=True, use json instead of pickle, and yaml.safe_load instead of yaml.load.

findings.title: Unsafe code execution or deserialization in Python
findings.message: yaml.load without a safe loader can run code
findings.remediation: Avoid eval and exec. Pass subprocess an argument list without shell=True, use json instead of pickle, and yaml.safe_load instead of yaml.load.

findings.title: No license
findings.remediation: Add a LICENSE file (choosealicense.com can help you pick one).

findings.title: No CI workflow
findings.remediation: Add a pipeline (for example GitHub Actions) that runs tests and `devshield scan`.

findings.title: .gitignore missing or incomplete
findings.remediation: Add a .gitignore for your stack that covers dependencies, build output and .env.

findings.title: CSRF protection disabled
findings.message: csrf_exempt turns CSRF protection off for this view
findings.remediation: Keep CSRF protection on for cookie-based sessions; disable it only for stateless token APIs, and scope the exemption to those endpoints.
